scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gavran/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @gavran/server" "npm run dev -w @gavran/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gavran/shared && npm run build -w @gavran/server && npm run build -w @gavran/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gavran/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gavran/server && npm run typecheck -w @gavran/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
